dataPartitions: Employee SELF only for the authenticated staff subject; manager FINANCE access is constrained to the authorized organization/site/branch; SYSTEM access is purpose-bound with verified caller; no cross-employee or cross-branch salary lookup.

failureSemantics: Missing employment link, active approved compensation policy, field grant or authoritative staff identity fails closed; no zero-salary or default commission is inferred.
Conflict, stale source revision, invalid compensation interval, denied partition and dependency outage return distinct stable reasons without exposing salary or employee PII.
Never log unredacted salary, private employee documents, bank details, JWT or cross-staff revenue; audit only authorized fingerprints.
idempotencyConcurrency: Externally retried mutation uses scoped idempotency key and fingerprint with expected revision; concurrent interval overlap or actor reassignment is rejected.

refinements.context: Customer remains debtor even when an employee is responsible for collection; payout eligibility requires verified paid source and completed stay, never a mere booking confirmation.
inScope: Define booking completed/changed source, payment verified/refunded source and employee sales/collector attribution with distinct event and business keys.
Specify effective approved commission policy with split validation, currency/minor-unit rounding/remainder, service completion and paid-balance gates; no unapproved split defaults.
Pin append-only EARNED/PENDING/REVERSED ledger, partial payment/refund allocation and old attribution/policy replay fixtures.
outOfScope: Bank payout, wage tax or transfer of customer debt to employee.

artifacts: effective commission policy and ledger event schemas

interfaces: Version Finance commission-policy publication, source event ingestion and restricted employee/manager earning summary.
dataOwnership: Finance owns verified collection and earnings ledger; Booking owns booking completion and sales owner; User owns staff identity.
stateMachine: INELIGIBLE -> PENDING_COLLECTION/SERVICE -> EARNED -> PARTIALLY_REVERSED/FULLY_REVERSED via append-only entries.

dataPartitions: Employee SELF only for the authenticated staff subject; manager FINANCE access is constrained to the authorized organization/site/branch; SYSTEM access is purpose-bound with verified caller; no cross-employee or cross-branch salary lookup.
fieldGroups: FINANCIAL employee own amount; manager scope for aggregate, INTERNAL_AUDIT source/effective policy; SUMMARY no private wage.

failureSemantics: Missing employment link, active approved compensation policy, field grant or authoritative staff identity fails closed; no zero-salary or default commission is inferred.
Conflict, stale source revision, invalid compensation interval, denied partition and dependency outage return distinct stable reasons without exposing salary or employee PII.
Never log unredacted salary, private employee documents, bank details, JWT or cross-staff revenue; audit only authorized fingerprints.
idempotencyConcurrency: Externally retried mutation uses scoped idempotency key and fingerprint with expected revision; concurrent interval overlap or actor reassignment is rejected.
Historical effective-dated salary is immutable; a correction creates a new superseding revision, not an update to closed payroll history.
Source events use outbox/inbox event ID and aggregate revision so duplicates/reorder cannot create a second compensation fact.

acceptanceCriteria.given: approved split, completed booking and verified payment
acceptanceCriteria.then: one earned entry per source version has explicit sales and optional collection owner without customer debt transfer

acceptanceCriteria.given: unpaid booking, missing published policy or disputed payment
acceptanceCriteria.then: no payable earning or invented split is emitted

acceptanceCriteria.given: refund is partial and same event replays
acceptanceCriteria.then: one proportional compensating reversal is produced without editing past entries

tests: Run the exact commands in testCases; cover valid, cross-branch/employee denial, overlap or stale revision, retry and unavailable identity.
Attach owner-specific CI evidence and versioned fixture; no stub-only response counts as a working payroll or salary API.

testCases.evidence: VS-E24-S03-ST05: salary/identity approval and overlap/denial/replay fixture report
VS-E24-S03-ST05: salary/identity approval and overlap/denial/replay fixture report

observability: Use bounded employee pseudonym, policy version and correlation ID to trace lookup and change; never place salary or PII in metrics labels.
Expose stale identity, missing approval, rejected overlap and authorization denial counts to approved finance/SRE operators.
definitionOfDone: Named owner-specific artifact and migration/compatibility path are committed with passing tests and CI.
Positive, field-level denial, concurrent edit/replay and role revocation outcomes are linked in Jira; E24 actual feature remains open until implemented.
Record release rollback and compensation-policy approval evidence; never treat a proposed salary value as an approved default.
evidence: Repository PR and CI link.
Versioned contract and positive/negative fixture report.
Approved identity, policy and effective-interval/rollback evidence when activation is requested.
refinements.decisionNoteVi: platform_contracts owns only the stated E24 S01 slice. Finance alone stores effective employee compensation and salary; the checked-in service_finance migrations V1–V4 do not yet include a salary/profile table.
activationBlockers: A finance owner must explicitly approve compensation amounts, visibility and effective dates before activating real employee profiles; the specification does not set wages.
